test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt.

B. Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall.

C. Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people.

D. This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.
solution:
The correct answer is '**BCAD**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence B** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence and talks about the cold desert of '**Ladakh**'.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because the previous sentence talks about the cold desert and **Sentence C** further tells us what is the source of water for the people in Ladakh.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence D **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall.
 
• **C**: Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people.
 
• **A**: However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt.
 
• **D**: This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__*** Ladakh is a cold desert with a low average annual rainfall. Thus, glaciers have been the main source of water for the people. However, when areas in Leh began to experience water shortages, life didn’t grind to a halt. This was because Chewang Norphel, a retired civil engineer came up with the idea of artificial glaciers.*
